title: LibScript Packaging Specification Schema
description: Defines the packaging, branding, runtime detection, and deployment configuration for generating native installers

title.description: Display name of the application in wizard titles

version.description: Version number of the installer package

publisher.description: Company or organization name publishing the installer package

upgrade_code.description: GUID used by Windows Installer to track product versions and manage upgrades

topology.description: Specifies whether package compiles as an independent installer, an orchestrator chaining embedded child MSIs, or a shared modular dependency

database_contracts.description: Declarative database requirements and multi-tenant isolation configuration

engine.description: Target relational or document database engine required by the stack

min_version.description: Minimum supported semantic version string for the database engine

allow_shared_instance.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the stack can share a database server instance with peer applications

default_schema_name.description: Default database or keyspace name for tenant isolation

default_port.description: Default TCP listening port for database engine

ssl_required.description: Whether TLS encryption is mandatory for remote DBaaS connections

dbaas_supported.description: Whether remote cloud managed connection strings are accepted

services.description: Declarative multi-daemon services supporting n-tier architectures

id.description: Unique identifier for the service daemon (e.g. lms, cms, celery-worker)

port_binding.description: TCP port mapping for HTTP-bound application servers

environment_overrides.description: Map of static environment overrides required by this specific service

wsgi_entrypoint.description: Python WSGI/ASGI application entrypoint module (e.g. myapp.wsgi:application)

worker_class.description: Celery worker class or generic daemon runner invocation

chained_packages.description: Child component packages orchestrated and installed via MsiEmbeddedChainer

items.description: Child package configuration within the suite orchestrator

id.description: Identifier of the child package in the chainer table

component.description: Sub-directory or component identifier matching repository catalog

upgrade_code.description: WiX UpgradeCode GUID for product state inspection

install_condition.description: WiX conditional expression governing child package installation

property_forwarding.description: Map of master installer public properties forwarded to child package

ui_wizard.description: Declarative definition of installer wizard sequence and dialog flow

page_type.description: Standard dialog template type in wizard flow

title.description: Custom header title for the dialog page

subtitle.description: Custom subheader or explanation text for the dialog page

condition.description: Conditional expression determining if page should be displayed

fields.description: Interactive form fields and property bindings on this page

items.description: Form input field on wizard page

name.description: Field label text displayed next to control

property.description: MSI public property bound to this field

control_type.description: UI control type rendered on the wizard page

default.description: Default initial value for the field

validation_regex.description: Regular expression pattern validating user input before proceeding

validation_message.description: Error message displayed if input fails validation_regex

branding_palette.description: Color palette and artwork parameters for automatic installer branding synthesis

primary_color.description: Hex color string for title banners and side splash gradients (e.g. #0078D4)

secondary_color.description: Hex color string for gradient transitions (e.g. #2B88D8)

dark_color.description: Hex color string for background contrast and typography (e.g. #101820)

app_title.description: Application title text rendered into synthetic splash bitmaps

items.description: Component name or path whose legal text is aggregated into the RTF EULA

eula_components.description: Array of component names whose legal texts are concatenated into RTF EULA

branding.description: Visual assets and branding artwork customized for installer dialogs

icon.description: Path to the application icon file (.ico)

banner_top.description: Path to top banner bitmap image (.bmp, 493x58)

banner_side.description: Path to welcome dialog side splash bitmap image (.bmp, 164x312)

license_rtf.description: Path to Rich Text Format or plain text EULA document

license_mode.description: Interactive license agreement presentation style in wizard UI

require_all_accepted.description: Enforces that installer cannot advance unless all bundled component licenses are accepted

bundled_licenses.description: Explicit per-component license configuration overrides and specifications

items.description: License agreement specification for an embedded software component

component.description: Identifier of the bundled component matching catalog manifest

title.description: Display name of the component presented in the license dialog header

spdx_id.description: Standard SPDX license identifier expression (e.g. GPL-2.0-only, BSD-3-Clause)

license_file.description: Filesystem path to local RTF or TXT legal agreement document

mandatory.description: Whether acceptance is required to proceed with installation

directories.description: Default installation, data, and log target directory paths

app_default.description: Default program files installation folder path

data_default.description: Default folder path for database files and mutable state

logs_default.description: Default folder path for service and operational log files

backups_default.description: Default folder path for snapshots and backup archives

runtime_searches.description: Pre-requisite runtime dependencies to detect on the host machine

items.description: Specification for detecting an installed runtime dependency

title.description: Display name of the runtime in UI dialogs

required.description: Indicates whether the runtime is mandatory for operation

registry_searches.description: Registry locations to probe for installed runtime paths

items.description: Registry key and value search criteria

file.description: Executable file name to verify inside target directory

win64.description: Whether to query the 64-bit registry view

path_command.description: CLI command to test availability in system PATH

version_regex.description: Regular expression pattern to parse version from command output

source_repository.description: Configuration for the application's source git repository and branch options

default_branch.description: Default Git branch, release tag, or commit

presets.description: Predefined release branch or tag selections

items.description: Named branch or tag preset option

label.description: Display label for the preset choice

value.description: Git branch or tag name represented by the preset

supports_auth_token.description: Indicates whether private repository token authentication is supported

browser_launch.description: Post-installation browser URLs and applications to launch

targets.description: List of URLs and options to open after installation completes

id.description: Unique identifier for the launch target

title.description: Checkbox label text displayed in completion dialog

default.description: Whether launch checkbox is initially checked

url_template.description: Target web address or parameterized URL template

features.description: Hierarchical feature tree of optional or configurable stack components

items.description: Single configurable feature component in installer

title.description: Display label in feature selection tree

description.description: Detailed explanation of the feature and its role

default.description: Whether feature is selected by default

mandatory.description: Whether feature cannot be deselected by user

shortcuts.description: Administrative shortcuts to create in the Start Menu and Desktop

title.description: Display title on Desktop or Start Menu

target.description: Executable binary or script targeted by shortcut

arguments.description: Command line arguments passed to target

icon.description: Icon resource file for the shortcut

wizard_copy.description: Declarative UI copy, labels, and default values rendered inside installer wizard dialogs

welcome_description_online.description: Description text shown on Dlg_Welcome for online installer builds

welcome_description_offline.description: Description text shown on Dlg_Welcome for offline air-gapped installer builds

exit_description.description: Completion message shown on Dlg_Exit when setup finishes

non_optional_summary.description: Multi-line summary of always-installed core stack components shown on Dlg_Features

port_1_label.description: Label text for primary service port on Dlg_Config

port_1_default.description: Default TCP port string for primary service on Dlg_Config

port_2_label.description: Label text for secondary or administrative service port on Dlg_Config

port_2_default.description: Default TCP port string for secondary or administrative service on Dlg_Config

default_admin_email.description: Default administrator email address pre-populated on Dlg_Config

default_theme.description: Default theme identifier pre-populated on Dlg_Config

verification_screenshots.description: Declarative post-install running-system and browser verification screenshot specifications

items.description: Single post-install verification screenshot step specification

id.description: Step identifier and output PNG filename stem

aliases.description: Optional additional filename stems to copy the captured screenshot to

title.description: Human-readable title of the captured view or browser tab

crop_mode.description: Window bounding-box cropping mode applied to the captured screenshot

service_port.description: TCP port to wait for readiness before capturing

healthcheck_path.description: HTTP path probed until 200 OK before capturing

url_template.description: Target URL or template navigated to in the browser

secondary_url_template.description: Optional secondary browser tab URL opened alongside the primary URL

auth_flow.description: Declarative authentication workflow for browser_authenticated views

login_url.description: Login page URL where credentials are submitted

username_selector.description: CSS/DOM selector for the username or email input field

password_selector.description: CSS/DOM selector for the password input field

submit_selector.description: CSS/DOM selector for the login form submit button

username_value.description: Default username or email used during automated verification login

password_value.description: Default password used during automated verification login

ready_selector.description: CSS/DOM selector or title substring confirming successful login before capture

view_spec.description: Declarative visual layout metadata for deterministic browser and desktop rendering across all OS environments

layout.description: Visual layout archetype (e.g. desktop_icons, wp_frontend, wp_login, wp_admin_dashboard, wp_site_health, login_card, course_dashboard, studio_table, service_portal)

active_tab_title.description: Title text displayed in the active browser tab

inactive_tab_title.description: Optional title text displayed in the background browser tab

active_tab_index.description: 1-based index of the active tab in the browser tab bar

header_bg.description: Hex color of the application top navigation bar

header_brand.description: Brand title rendered on the left of the application header

header_subtitle.description: Subtitle rendered next to the brand in the application header

user_badge.description: Authenticated user badge text displayed on the right of the header

heading.description: Primary page heading or login card title

subheading.description: Secondary descriptive text or status subtitle

sidebar_items.description: Navigation items rendered in the left administration sidebar

desktop_icons.description: Desktop shortcut icons rendered for desktop capture steps

badge.description: Short 2-4 character badge text on the icon tile

label.description: Shortcut label text beneath the icon

color.description: Hex accent color for the icon badge

cards.description: Dashboard cards, widgets, or status panels rendered in the main view

badge.description: Action button or status badge label

color.description: Hex color for card banner or badge

lifecycle_hooks.description: Declarative lifecycle hooks for operations like data migrations, search indexing, and static asset compilation

pre_install.description: Actions to execute before stack files and services are provisioned

post_install.description: Actions or checks to execute after stack files and services are provisioned

on_upgrade.description: Actions to execute specifically during a product upgrade cycle

hook_action.description: Custom action or verification probe definition

description.description: Description of the operation performed by action

command.description: Shell command or script invoked during execution
